metadata.title: A two-step ideal sub-Riemannian structure with no measure contraction properties
metadata.abstract: We construct a compact, equiregular, ideal sub-Riemannian manifold of step $2$ such that, for every smooth positive measure, the $\mathrm{MCP}(K,N)$ fails for all $K\in\mathbb{R}$ and $N \in (1,\infty)$. This shows that the real-analyticity assumption in the measure contraction theorem of Badreddine and Rifford in arXiv:1712.09900v2 cannot be replaced by smoothness. Moreover, our structure is ideal, i.e. it admits no non-trivial abnormal minimizing geodesics. Although failures of the measure contraction property for ideal structures were recently obtained in the higher-step setting, our construction shows that the phenomenon can already occur on compact, equiregular, ideal structures of step $2$. The proof exploits a differential consequence of the measure contraction property, namely a uniform upper bound for the sub-Laplacian of the squared distance near its base point, and constructs a structure for which this quantity is unbounded.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 二步理想亚 Riemannian 几何的 MCP 反例
analysis.workSummary: 在 R⁴ 构造光滑等正则二步理想结构，使距离平方的亚 Laplacian 沿趋于基点的光滑点无界；再选周期参数函数并取余紧格商得到紧致反例，排除任意光滑正测度的所有有限维 MCP。
analysis.breakthrough: 说明测度收缩定理中的实解析条件不能直接弱化为光滑，即使在二步理想结构中也会失败。
analysis.limitations: ideal 只排除非平凡异常极短测地线，弱于 fat 分布；反例不否定 fat 结构或实解析条件下的正面 MCP 定理。
